title: Module quiz: Claude in the apps

questions.stem: A recruiter's Project answers hiring questions from a policy file that HR revises each quarter in a shared drive. The recruiter wants current answers without re-uploading, and wants candidate notes unseen by others who have access. Which design fits?

options.text: Upload the latest version each period, and share the space so HR can check it
options.says: Ruled out because "an uploaded file is a copy as of the day you uploaded it", and sharing exposes everything the knowledge holds.

options.text: Sync the source document, and leave private material out of the knowledge
options.says: A synced document follows its source, and the knowledge base is readable by everyone with access, so private notes stay out (pages 1 and 3).

options.text: Type the policy wording into the instructions, since those are always read
options.says: Ruled out because "A figure typed into the instructions is a second copy that no file update will touch".

options.text: Switch on Research for every question, so the wording is looked up on the web
options.says: Ruled out because "Do not use it for a question that one document answers", and a policy file is that case.

origin.section: Connecting a document instead of copying it

questions.stem: A department wants a monthly report in one layout, built from figures kept in a shared spreadsheet and delivered to a client in editable form. Which combination fits best?

options.text: A Project for the data, a plugin for the buyer and a skill for the output
options.says: Ruled out because a plugin is "A role's bundle of procedures and connections", and not the means of handing one deliverable to one buyer.

options.text: Research for the data, memory for the procedure and an inline reply for the output
options.says: Ruled out because "A short answer stays inline in the chat", which does not suit a file to be edited.

options.text: A skill for the procedure, a connector for the data, an artifact for the output
options.says: A skill carries a repeatable procedure, a connector reads live data, and an artifact is a deliverable someone can open and edit.

options.text: Three separate chats, one per stage, with material copied across by hand
options.says: Ruled out because "A skill is a reusable procedure Claude pulls in when the task matches", which copying by hand gives up.

questions.stem: A new hire installs a free skill found on a public forum. Its page says the skill also needs a custom connector to the hire's work email, and the hire's plan allows both. Which step belongs before installing?

options.text: Confirm that the plan lists skills and custom connectors, then install it
options.says: Ruled out because "A skill can carry scripts and instructions that Claude follows", so plan availability says nothing about safety.

options.text: Trial it in a private chat first and judge it by the first few replies
options.says: Ruled out because the page says to "review code dependencies and bundled resources first", and a first reply cannot show them.

options.text: Install it on the hire's account only, so colleagues stay out of reach
options.says: Ruled out because "The page names prompt injection and data exfiltration as the most significant risks", and the mailbox in danger is the installer's own.

options.text: Inspect the package contents and confirm who operates the server it calls
options.says: A skill carries instructions and scripts that Claude follows, and a custom connector "has not been verified by Anthropic", so the contents and the operator need checking first.

questions.stem: Two colleagues ask the same shared Project about one finance folder. One receives a summary, the other is told nothing was found. Both reached the storage through the same custom connector, which the owner enabled. What should the owner check first?

options.text: Reconnect the storage for the second colleague under the owner's credentials
options.says: Ruled out because a connector "does not bypass the source system's permissions".

options.text: Reword the Project instructions to search the whole folder
options.says: Ruled out because "Fixing a connector's reach is done in the source system, by changing who can open what, not by rewording an instruction".

options.text: Switch the connector to On demand so tools stop crowding the chat
options.says: Ruled out because On demand is suggested "when you have ten or more connectors, so that the conversation is not crowded with tools", which is about loading and not about reach.

options.text: Compare what each of them is allowed to see in the source system
options.says: Claude inherits each person's permissions, so two people can get different answers because they can see different files.
